scope: Case-sensitive callback string languages. First-separator pairs and finite choices with arbitrary suffix prefixes. OS NUL and command parser timing are checked separately. Source fingerprints also cover reached message-file nonempty checks; filesystem access remains native.

anonymize-map.source: builtin/fast-export.c:parse_opt_anonymize_map; both sides of the first separator must be nonempty

fast-import-sign.source: gpg-interface.c:parse_sign_mode; builtin/fast-import.c:parse_one_option; a key suffix may be empty

column-mode.source: column.c:parse_config/parse_option/parseopt_column_callback; enable projection only; auto depends on tty/pager during finalization

revision-date-format.source: date.c:parse_date_type/parse_date_format; revision.c:parse_long_opt(date). Case-sensitive mode and optional -local suffix; format requires a colon and accepts arbitrary strftime text. auto: suffix validation depends on stdout TTY/pager and remains native-owned, including empty or malformed suffixes.

diff-output-indicator.source: diff.c:diff_opt_char; nonempty argv accepts exactly one byte. Empty argv reads arg[1] beyond its terminator, so its native behavior remains delegated.

diff-rename-score.source: Git 2.25.1/2.55.0 diff.c:parse_rename_score and diff_opt_find_renames/diff_opt_find_copies; ASCII digits, optional single dot, optional terminal percent; empty/bare accepted. Only lexical acceptance, not the native stored score.

diff-break-score.source: Git 2.25.1/2.55.0 diff.c:diff_opt_break_rewrites; one or two rename-score fields separated by at most one slash; fields may be empty, bare accepted. Raw values stay unchanged.
